schema.help: air temperature at noon, estimated for the cell from nearby weather stations
schema.label: Temperature
schema.name: temp

schema.help: relative humidity at noon
schema.label: Humidity
schema.name: rh

schema.help: wind speed at noon
schema.label: Wind
schema.name: ws

schema.help: rain in the 24 hours to noon
schema.label: Rain
schema.name: precip

schema.help: how dry the litter and small fuels on the surface are; changes within a day
schema.label: Fine Fuel Moisture Code (FFMC)
schema.name: ffmc

schema.help: how dry the loosely packed decaying layer a few cm down is; changes over about two weeks
schema.label: Duff Moisture Code (DMC)
schema.name: dmc

schema.help: how dry the deep, compact organic layer is: long-term, seasonal drying
schema.label: Drought Code (DC)
schema.name: dc

schema.help: how fast a fire would spread (fine-fuel dryness and wind)
schema.label: Initial Spread Index (ISI)
schema.name: isi

schema.help: how much fuel is available to burn (from DMC and DC)
schema.label: Buildup Index (BUI)
schema.name: bui

schema.help: overall fire danger: the intensity of a spreading fire (from ISI and BUI)
schema.label: Fire Weather Index (FWI)
schema.name: fwi

schema.help: distance to the nearest station that reported that day; farther means less certain values
schema.label: Nearest weather station
schema.name: fwi_station_km

schema.help: average FWI over the day and the 6 days before
schema.label: FWI, past week
schema.name: fwi_mean_7d

schema.help: days of the last 30 with an FWI of at least 19
schema.label: High-FWI days, past 30
schema.name: fwi_days_ge19_30d

schema.help: total rain over the last 30 days
schema.label: Rain, past 30 days
schema.name: precip_sum_30d

schema.help: DC minus the cell's 1980-2022 average for this time of the season (positive = drier than usual)
schema.label: Drought Code vs normal
schema.name: dc_anom

schema.help: 7-day FWI minus the cell's 1980-2022 average for this time of the season
schema.label: Past-week FWI vs normal
schema.name: fwi_mean_7d_anom

schema.help: 30-day rain minus the cell's 1980-2022 average for this time of the season (negative = drier)
schema.label: 30-day rain vs normal
schema.name: precip_sum_30d_anom

schema.help: 7-day mean noon temperature minus the cell's 1980-2022 average for this time of the season
schema.label: Past-week temperature vs normal
schema.name: temp_mean_7d_anom

schema.help: counted fires reported within 28 km of the centre in the 7 days before
schema.label: Fires in this zone, past week
schema.name: fires_28km_7d

schema.help: counted fires reported within 100 km in the 30 days before
schema.label: Fires within 100 km, past 30 days
schema.name: fires_100km_30d

schema.help: counted fires reported with a natural cause, mostly lightning (from fire reports, not lightning-strike data)
schema.label: Natural-cause fires within 100 km, past 30 days
schema.name: lightning_fires_100km_30d

schema.help: counted fires recorded in the cell in the 5 years before this one (blank if one of those years had no agency record)
schema.label: Fires in this 10 km square, past 5 years
schema.name: own_fires_last5

schema.help: in this cell, from records since 1972
schema.label: Years since the last recorded fire here
schema.name: years_since_last_fire

schema.help: total reported size of the fires recorded in this cell since 1972 (they may have spread beyond the cell)
schema.label: Area of past fires that started here
schema.name: hist_burned_km2_prior

schema.help: most common fuel type in the cell on the 2024 national fuel map
schema.label: Main fuel type
schema.name: fuel_type_majority

model.label: Research model fitted on 1980-2023 (its decision tree on 2015-2023)
model.note: 2024 and 2025 were used to decide how long to train the model, so these forecasts are not a clean test.
